css: .tb-h-rounded-pill{position:relative;background:var(--tb-color-surface);color:var(--tb-color-text)}.tb-h-rounded-pill__inner{max-width:var(--tb-h-rounded-pill-width);margin:auto;padding:0 24px}.tb-h-rounded-pill__brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--tb-color-secondary);text-decoration:none;font-weight:900}.tb-h-rounded-pill__logo{width:38px;height:38px;object-fit:contain}.tb-h-rounded-pill__brand-name{letter-spacing:-.025em}.tb-h-rounded-pill__nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.tb-h-rounded-pill__link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:9px 11px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;font-weight:750}.tb-h-rounded-pill__link:hover{color:var(--tb-color-primary)}.tb-h-rounded-pill__parent{position:relative}.tb-h-rounded-pill__submenu{position:absolute;z-index:20;top:100%;left:0;min-width:190px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--tb-color-border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--tb-color-surface);display:none;box-shadow:0 16px 38px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tb-color-secondary) 14%,transparent)}.tb-h-rounded-pill__submenu .tb-h-rounded-pill__link{display:flex}.tb-h-rounded-pill__parent:hover>.tb-h-rounded-pill__submenu,.tb-h-rounded-pill__parent:focus-within>.tb-h-rounded-pill__submenu{display:grid}.tb-h-rounded-pill__chevron{font-size:10px;opacity:.65}.tb-h-rounded-pill{padding:18px 0;background:var(--tb-color-background)}.tb-h-rounded-pill__pill{min-height:62px;padding:8px 12px 8px 16px;border:1px solid var(--tb-color-border);border-radius:999px;background:var(--tb-color-surface);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;box-shadow:0 14px 34px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tb-color-secondary) 8%,transparent)}.tb-h-rounded-pill__logo{width:32px;height:32px}.tb-h-rounded-pill__nav{margin-left:auto}.tb-h-rounded-pill__link{padding:8px 9px}.tb-h-rounded-pill__cta{padding:10px 15px;border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:850}@media(max-width:820px){.tb-h-rounded-pill__row,.tb-h-rounded-pill__top,.tb-h-rounded-pill__glass,.tb-h-rounded-pill__frame,.tb-h-rounded-pill__pill{flex-wrap:wrap;height:auto;padding-top:14px;padding-bottom:14px}.tb-h-rounded-pill__nav{width:100%;order:5}.tb-h-rounded-pill__submenu{position:static;box-shadow:none}}@media(max-width:560px){.tb-h-rounded-pill__inner{padding-left:16px;padding-right:16px}.tb-h-rounded-pill__row{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.tb-h-rounded-pill__search{width:100%!important}}
name: Rounded Pill Header
description: A floating pill-shaped navigation header with compact brand and action.
